EC1: - Participants will be excluded if they:
EC2: - Have any communication difficulties that would [NOT] prevent them from engaging in the intervention (including hearing impairments, [OR] visual impairments, [NOT] inability to understand English). These will be assessed at researcher's discretion during baseline assessments.
EC3: - Had a diagnosis of dementia prior to the stroke.
EC4: - Are deemed to lack capacity to give informed consent. This will be judged via a qualified clinician.
EC5: - Have had previous experience of CFT
EC6: - Were receiving medical [OR] or psychological treatment for a mental illness at the time of their stroke.
